text: {"bull":["Operating profit margin remained stable at 13% across all quarters in FY'25‑26, indicating consistent profitability despite revenue fluctuations.","Order inflows grew 14% YoY in Q1 FY'27, with international order share rising to 55%, supporting future revenue growth.","The total order book increased 27% YoY to Rs 7.79 trillion as of June 2026, providing a strong pipeline for the next fiscal year.","Operating profit rose to ₹35,411 cr in FY'26, up from ₹34,427 cr in FY'25, showing incremental earnings growth."],"bear":["Net profit fell to ₹3,825 cr in Q4 FY'26 from ₹4,678 cr in Q3 FY'26, reflecting pressure on earnings in the quarter.","Quarterly sales dipped to ₹63,679 cr in Jun 2025 from ₹74,392 cr in Mar 2025, indicating volatility in revenue generation.","Operating profit margin slipped to 12% in Jun 2026 from a consistent 13% in prior quarters, suggesting margin compression.","Revenue growth in FY'26 was 12% versus the guided 15%, highlighting execution challenges and slower top‑line expansion."]}
